deviations.text: H sealed until a parent-written HOLDOUT_RELEASE_v1.json is committed; Stage D truncates every input at 2019-12-31 (J4 formations <= 2015-12). Narrows access only; header unchanged.
Pivot tables and J2 episode holdings cover D episodes only; G4 and the H half of G6 not evaluated; all G6 rows D-only and provisional.
Power lines (SE, MDE80 at Holm alpha/m).
DSR trial count = sum of ledger effective_n over rotation_core_v1, thematic_rotation_phase0, cross_asset_phase0, index_direction_phase0 (124), ledger blob pinned at 623f0a4623.
Long-history J1 tier remainder (French market 1928-1997; Sahm rule from 1960; DBAA-DGS10 credit from 1987).

J2_industry_etf (16 industry ETFs): deferred, not run, no result (parent acknowledged 2026-11-11; J2 in this run covers the SPDR sector ETFs only, not industries). J2_L (French 12 industries) and J3_L (proxy tier): deferred, not run, no result.

RSP (equal-weight S&P 500) is not a header comparator. J1/J3 lines vs SPY and RSP and stress-episode capture are labelled post-hoc descriptive, are in no test family and affect no gate. RSP starts 2003-05-01, so its lines cover 2003-05..2019-12 only.
Re-review findings N1, N2, F6 were fixed and self-reviewed (no third review), per the lead's call acknowledged by the parent.
Pivot presentation; J2 episode holdings; J4 implementation details; interior missing-close forward fill.

Fixed before any outcome: X rebuilt per era; pivot start-up spell and spells starting in D's last 63 sessions excluded from false pivots (counted as undetermined_sealed); deviations recorded; block-63 and block-6 sensitivities; incumbent Holm at m=8 with unavailable tests at p=1; J4 keeps whole-interval masking of every identity-suspect interval (re-review N1: reused tickers) - conservative, lowers coverage; J4 S&P 1500 sensitivity from 2013; J4 eras by label date; J4 statistics over formations with a finite delta; exit-before-trough strict and 3 H episodes; clip logging; one-way turnover, TE and IR per contrast; ledger pinned; dirty-harness refusal; G6 rows labelled provisional.
J5-B and B2 bond leg = VFITX before 2002-08-01 then IEF (header B2 rule applied consistently); GLD eligible for J5-B's defensive leg from its 253rd session (2005-11).

After the first Stage D run, the J4 clip-log 'examples' list was found to list (ticker, first-session) pairs instead of the clipped (ticker, date) pairs (pandas stack keeps NaN). The list was fixed and Stage D re-run once; every statistic was verified identical to the first run (only examples, timestamps, code commit and input hashes of the code differ).

Bootstrap seeds: base 20261110 with family offsets (+1000 J2, +2000 J3, +3000 FI, +4000 J4, +500000 block sensitivity); chunks use seed+k, so adjacent tests share random streams (common random numbers, no bias).
